assessments.reasoning: The dated and approved SDC field note names Jules I. Schwartz and repeats its report number in page headers. The title has an open-publication restriction, and its introduction identifies the same-date interpreter scope. The fresh PDF hash and every associated raw page, image and content object range match. The cited physical pages were rerendered and inspected at 139 dpi. The displayed passage at FN-LO-34-2, §§9.1 and 9.3, Definition of Compound Statements and nested compound statements, printed p. 27 / PDF p. 27 addresses the proposition. Section 9.1 names BEGIN and END as the brackets. Section 9.3 specifies compound statements within other compound statements and calls for a matching END for each BEGIN. The assessment stays within the named dated SDC document and its scope. It assesses documentary wording, not execution on a specific implementation. The written nesting rule and example directly agree. Labels and control flow into or past the compound illustrate separate issues. The claim does not equate the grouping structure with later forms of lexical scope.
